note: The real photo for each cat card, looked up through api.fxtwitter.com: the first fitting photo (or video still) in the cat's X proof post, or, where the proof has none, a post of the same cat by its owner or official account (source: "search"). Only the pbs.twimg.com address and the credit are kept; the image is hotlinked, never copied into this repo. Photos showing real people's faces are left out. Keys: planned tickers, adoptable tickers, Hall of Fame symbols. `none` records why a cat has no real photo.
